authority: POWO/WCVP (direct species pages); ITIS for Solidago juliae historic synonym treatment

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts S. thunbergii; historical Spiraea japonica Raf. is an illegitimate name synonymized here and must not be confused with independently accepted Spiraea japonica L.f. Spiraea crenata Thunb. is a heterotypic synonym.
records.concept_action: Keep author-specific S. japonica Raf. alias separate from accepted S. japonica L.f.; no specimen reassignment.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts S. albus with varieties albus and laevigatus; source pool species-rank only. Historical Vaccinium album L. and Symphoria albus (L.) Raf. are homotypic synonyms; Lonicera alba (L.) Druce is an illegitimate later homonym. Do not infer variety.
records.concept_action: Retain accepted species concept; do not install or rename learner cards in taxonomy lane.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts S. tinctoria; Hopea tinctoria L. and Eugenioides tinctorium (L.) Kuntze are homotypic synonyms; historical varieties ashei and pygmaea are heterotypic synonyms. Preserve aliases; no separate variety card.
records.concept_action: Retain accepted species concept; do not install or rename learner cards in taxonomy lane.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts T. aurantiacum; Phemeranthus aurantiacus (Engelm.) Kiger and Claytonia aurantiaca (Engelm.) Kuntze are homotypic synonyms; Talinum whitei I.M.Johnst. heterotypic synonym. Existing source alias Phemeranthus aurantiacus should not produce a duplicate learner card.
records.concept_action: Record Phemeranthus aurantiacus as synonym alias to Talinum aurantiacum; defer any cross-row or learner edit to installer.
